Serve chainmail's tools to an AI agent over the Model Context Protocol.

The agent's MCP client starts this command and speaks MCP on stdin and
stdout. Diagnostics go to stderr. Calls go to the daemon at --socket, then
$CHAINMAIL\_SOCKET, then cli.toml, then the default socket, and the audit log records them
with client kind mcp. The command starts and lists its tools even when the
daemon is down; calls then fail with DAEMON\_UNREACHABLE.

Register it with Claude Code:

```text
claude mcp add --scope user chainmail -- /run/current-system/sw/bin/chainmail mcp
```

## Usage

```text
chainmail mcp
```

## Examples

```sh
# configure your agent to run this command over stdio
chainmail mcp
```

## Global flags

```text
      --output string   output format: json or table (default $CHAINMAIL_OUTPUT, then cli.toml, then table on a terminal, json otherwise)
      --socket string   daemon socket (default $CHAINMAIL_SOCKET, then cli.toml, then /run/chainmail/chainmail.sock)
```
